name: calcolo-portate-aria
description: Calcolo Portate Aria - Android via Capacitor

scripts.android:init: npm run build:web && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
